rights_note: This manifest carries only assets that are BOTH local to this repo AND have a written rights basis. Every other stage-action candidate found for issue #637 is either already in the media library (nothing to ingest) or has no clearance on file. Uncleared assets are listed under not_for_ingestion, which ingest_media_manifest.py does not read, so --execute cannot upload them. Full reasoning and per-asset evidence: content/drafts/2026-07-26-speaking-page/photography-inventory.md.

assets.path_note: Relative to this manifest. The file is the tracked Aurora theme asset; it is not copied into this source pack because the theme copy is the tracked original.

assets.rights_basis: KK committed this file himself in 6b0ae1d (2026-07-25) as "the canonical approved event photo", which is the site-use approval. The photographer is NOT embedded in this copy (EXIF stripped); it was established by frame match against the BC + AI photo pipeline manifest for gallery vancouver-ai-meetup-2026-06, whose gallery photographer and per-photo photographer are both Michelle Diamond. A reuse scope confirmation from Michelle Diamond is NOT on file. Live precedent for the credit line exists on this site (media 12663). Do not upgrade this string to "cleared".

photographer_evidence.match_method: Fetched the 2048x1365 R2 derivative, downscaled to the theme copy's 1600x1066 and diffed: mean absolute per-channel difference 3.12 of 255 on a 1-in-41 pixel sample, which is resampling and recompression noise, not a different frame.
